seed: ask-makes-icons-that-are-icons-one-subject-clean, at Next defaults with no flag touched. On a blank picture an icon request makes the picture the icon: a square canvas, a frame with no surface, the parts as named shapes and paths, and the copied SVG has no picture in it. One Command Z takes it all back, canvas size included.

steps.note: the blank picture became the icon: 512 square, a clear frame, parts named for what they are

steps.comment: the background, the frame and a few parts, never the dozens a trace makes

steps.note: one Command Z took the icon back and the canvas is 1440 x 1024 again
